paired_primary_gains_vs_controls.definition: G_b = mean over the same 16 seeds of V_ridge_crossfit - V_control

screening_decision.meaning: Operational Stage A screen only; not a significance test, independent confirmation, or authorization for another phase.

conditional_bootstrap.method: conditional stratified percentile bootstrap of fixed OOF values
conditional_bootstrap.resampling_unit: seed within the four family-by-history strata; n=4 sampled with replacement per stratum
conditional_bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional resampling range for fixed held-out values only; no refitting, training uncertainty, formal 95% coverage, or p-value claim.

mse_diagnostic_only.use: diagnostic only; excluded from advancement gate

limitations: Sixteen complete seeds are the independent evaluation units; the 192 outcome cells and four overlapping training folds are not independent replications.
Balanced outcomes score the fixed held-out decisions only and do not enter targets, fitting, scaling, thresholds, or advancement criteria.
The conditional bootstrap resamples fixed OOF values within the four strata; it does not refit models or capture training uncertainty and makes no formal confidence-coverage or p-value claim.
A positive result is exploratory reuse of previously observed E161 labels and does not confirm deployment performance or establish the broader H033 claim.
